change: CurveYieldMorphoFeeSplitterV3: Safe-controlled configurable governance controller without changing V2 fee/accounting functions

controller.requires: caller is immutable Safe; target is deployed contract with same Morpho core, same Safe, and splitter() equal to new V3 splitter address

deployment.priorTransactionWriteBlock: Blockchain deployment request for corrected V3 owner was blocked by transaction safety checks in preceding work. No bypass or new deployment attempted in this update.

migrationConsiderations: The existing V2 splitter has an immutable governance pointer, so V3 must be deployed separately; the old splitter cannot be converted in place.
Initialize a fresh V3 splitter with Safe owner and V3 governance; V3 governance must call configureSplitter once for it before being used as market controller.
Set new fee recipient and transfer Morpho ownership with an approved Safe transaction sequence only after new controller/splitter are deployed and configured.

Existing splitter fee entitlements, creatorMarket configuration and balances do not automatically migrate. Preserve old claim rights, and separately address historical creator allocations if necessary.
Do not execute obsolete Safe proposal targeting the previous module.
